// Lists: ; && || and exit status.
$ true && echo yes; false && echo no
yes
[exit 1]
$ false || echo fallback
fallback
$ true || echo skipped
$ false; true && echo ran
ran
$ echo a; echo b ; echo c
a
b
c
$ bash -c "exit 3"; echo $?
3

// Pipes.
$ echo c b a | tr ' ' '\n' | sort
a
b
c
$ cat /etc/passwd | grep root | cut -d: -f1
root
$ nosuchcmd | wc -l
nosuchcmd: command not found
0
$ nosuchcmd 2>&1 | wc -l
1

// Groups and background jobs.
$ (echo a; echo b) | sort -r
b
a
$ (cd /tmp; pwd); pwd
/tmp
/root
$ sleep 1 &
[1] 25084
$ echo ok &
[2] 25085
ok

// Syntax errors.
$ | foo
-bash: syntax error near unexpected token `|'
[exit 2]
$ echo a;; echo b
-bash: syntax error near unexpected token `;'
[exit 2]
$ echo (
-bash: syntax error near unexpected token `('
[exit 2]
$ echo ok &&
-bash: syntax error near unexpected token `newline'
[exit 2]
$ if true; then echo yes; fi
if: command not found
then: command not found
fi: command not found
[exit 127]

// exit ends the session: nothing runs after it.
$ exit 3
[exit 3]
$ echo unreachable
[exit 3]
